title: Verified artifact reader
responsibility: Reads stored artifact bytes, checks their recorded hash and extracts structured run observations.

inputs.name: artifactText.value
inputs.description: Recorded value to render as text.

inputs.name: artifactBehavior.document
inputs.description: Parsed document to interpret as run observations.

inputs.name: explorerArtifact.capture
inputs.description: Recorded capture with media location, expected SHA-256 and optional gap explanation.

inputs.name: explorerArtifact.mediaBase
inputs.description: Address prefix prepended to the capture media filename.

inputs.name: explorerArtifact.fetcher
inputs.description: Optional byte-fetching function, defaulting to browser fetch.

outputs.name: artifactText
outputs.description: Not recorded for undefined, strings unchanged, otherwise indented JSON.

outputs.name: artifactBehavior
outputs.description: Structured scenario/environment/fixture, steps, input/output, assertions, trace and remaining fields, or null for a non-object or array. Uses the first recognized input and output aliases; assertions retain named status and additional details.

outputs.name: explorerArtifact
outputs.description: Resolves to verified text/document/behavior when bytes match the hash. Missing media, unsuccessful HTTP responses and hash mismatches return an unverified result with a problem; mismatched bytes remain text only. Non-JSON text may still be hash-verified.
